evidence.note: Free nflverse archive-final fallbacks and opening-line observations without opening juice remain valid research observations, but they are not promotion-quality entry-price evidence. ESPN provider-labeled archived opening/closing stages qualify without fabricating timestamps. ROBUST status requires verified entry prices plus positive uncertainty-adjusted ROI/CLV across multiple markets and seasons with broad closing-snapshot coverage.

source.entry_price_rule: Only the exact price observed at entry can qualify as verified entry-price evidence. Opening spread/total lines without opening juice remain research-only.
source.historical_entry_provenance: explicit provider-labeled opening stage or timestamped provider entry
source.notes: Archive-final values are not claimed to be timestamped official closes. When a distinct opening is unavailable, the final archive value is an explicit execution fallback and no CLV proxy is recorded.

model_card.name: Harbin NFL Analytics
non_negotiables: No sportsbook line in the independent fair-score engine.
NFL parameters are validated independently from CFB.
Current betting requires an identified, decision-ready expected starting QB for both teams.
A starter change relative to the last-observed QB remains betting-blocked until a validated replacement-QB adjustment exists.
Prior-week injury designations cannot carry forward as current risk; injury, depth, and roster context must be FRESH.
Historical archive fallbacks do not become verified opening entries by relabeling.
No production staking until every hard release gate passes.

model_card.purpose: Leakage-safe NFL fair-score, probability, market-research, portfolio-risk, grading, and monitoring platform.
